latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of erc8128.

- Enables signing and verifying HTTP requests using Ethereum wallets (ERC-8128 standard).
- Supports both a JavaScript library (@slicekit/erc8128) and command-line interface (erc8128 curl).
- Provides replay protection, nonce support, request binding options, and request integrity features.
- Includes extensible verification policies and integration patterns for APIs and agent-based authentication.
- Comprehensive documentation links and common implementation patterns for servers and bots.
